view34: Each block has a light 3-4px top plane and a taller front face below, but several blocks (upper-center cols 17-18 rows 5-12, right cols 25-26 rows 10-15, lower-left cols 14-15 rows 22-26) also show a 2px-wide shaded right-hand side face.
style: Material-tinted dark brown edges (nearBlackEdge 0) and 5-6 tones are present, but all seven blocks repeat an identical cookie-cutter template (bright cream rounded cap, mid-taupe front with one tan dot and one dark dot, dark brown base band) rather than varied Beodeul stonework.
reasons: All seven blocks repeat the same stamped loaf-like motif (bright cream rounded top cap + grey-taupe front with identical two-dot speckle + dark brown base stripe), reading as stacked uniform boxes/loaves rather than fractured collapsed temple masonry.
High contrast between the bright cream top caps and darker grey-taupe vertical faces makes the tops read like separate caps/frosting rather than planar cuts of the same stone material.
Several blocks include a 2px-wide dark right-hand side plane (cols 17-18, 25-26, 14-15), introducing slight oblique side faces.
